editor.parametersAfterSave: Parameters are generated from the primary table, related tables, and field allowlists after saving.
editor.enabledHelp: When disabled, assigned agents can no longer load this interaction.
editor.confirmationHelp: Read-only queries may also require confirmation when data is sensitive.
